text.en: Pet owners consistently highlight Dr Miriam, Dr Michael, and the practice team for their clinical excellence and warm bedside manner. Clients value the empathetic communication shown during consultations, noting that the veterinarians explain health matters with patience and genuine kindness.

title.en: Gentle handling for dogs and cats

text.en: Reviewers note that both dogs and cats receive calm, considerate care during their visits to the Gilford Road clinic. Pet parents appreciate that nervous animals feel comfortable with the staff, ensuring clinical examinations proceed smoothly without creating distress for the pets.

Clients praise the high standard of care delivered across preventive health checks, ongoing medical treatments, and sensitive end-of-life support. Owners point out that prompt appointment scheduling and thorough diagnostic assessments provide valuable reassurance for local families.

a.en: Yes, clients report that the clinic often accommodates urgent same-day consultations when pets need prompt attention.
The practice is situated at 15c Gilford Road in Sandymount, Dublin 4.

q.en: What clinical services are provided at the clinic?
